args.body: Prioritize the open-software-tenders retirement decision now that the latest receipt is past 18 November 09:00 UTC. Read the current retirement mission, any superseding expiry obligations, the exact live release receipt and any prior retirement result. If the authoritative cutoff applies to the entire live site and retirement is still pending, take it offline through PUBLISH_SITE and verify the public result with FETCH. If a later verified release has different expiry obligations, follow those and verify that expired content is no longer presented as open. Reuse the completed award-link removal evidence. Read the saved result before closing under a valid lease with a lesson. Preserve the November 20 welfare checkpoint, December 4 at 17:00 UTC welfare retirement and the host's exact-digest review gate for public revisions.
